description: This Java source file defines a fragment class LogFragment that displays log data within an Android application. It creates a view hierarchy including a LogView inside a ScrollView, sets various UI properties, and updates the scroll position when log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a scrollable logview for showing log data within an Android app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the view hierarchy comprising a ScrollView containing a LogView, with layout and style configurations.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overridden Fragment method that initializes the views and sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when logs are updated.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in this fragment.
